sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Ecommerce SEO Services Kochi

items.q: How is ecommerce SEO different from regular SEO?
items.a: Ecommerce SEO deals with challenges specific to product and category pages — duplicate content across variants, filtered URLs, and structured data for pricing and reviews — that regular content pages don't face.

items.q: Can you fix duplicate content across product variants?
items.a: Yes. This is one of the most common ecommerce SEO problems — online store SEO audit Kochi work identifies duplicate or near-identical product descriptions and resolves them through content differentiation or canonicalization.

items.q: Do you optimize for a specific ecommerce platform?
items.a: Our ecommerce SEO strategy Kochi approach works across WooCommerce, Shopify, and custom platforms — the underlying SEO principles apply regardless of the platform, though implementation details vary slightly.

items.q: Will ecommerce SEO help reduce our paid advertising costs?
items.a: Over time, yes. As organic rankings improve for product and category pages, many clients see reduced reliance on paid ads for the same search terms, improving overall marketing ROI.

items.q: How long does ecommerce SEO take to show results?
items.a: Product-page improvements can show within 6–10 weeks, though category-level authority and competitive keyword rankings typically build over 3–6 months as content and links accumulate.

items.q: Do you handle product schema markup for reviews and pricing?
items.a: Yes. Product schema markup services are applied to help listings show enhanced search results — pricing, availability, and star ratings directly in search, which improves click-through rates.
